original_prompt:
HIGH RESOLUTION PHOTOGRAPHIC RESTORATION of approved character 06. Deliver a single native high-resolution full-body portrait, target 2048 x 3072 pixels or highest available portrait resolution, with genuinely resolved fine detail.
IMAGE 1 is the approved FULL-BODY master: strictly preserve its silhouette, exact leg-to-torso ratio, leg thickness, waist, overall build, head size relative to body, hand positions, stance, outfit cut, hem lengths, shoes, composition and camera angle. These proportions are FINAL and must not be redesigned.
IMAGE 2 is the original FACE AND PHOTOGRAPHIC TEXTURE reference for the same character. Restore this person's facial identity and real photographic skin/hair/material quality lost after repeated edits. Use it only for identity and genuine optical detail; do not use its close-up framing or alter the approved body.
Re-render IMAGE 1 as a fresh premium studio photograph with clean, finely resolved eyelashes, irises, individual hair strands, age-appropriate subtle skin pores and wrinkles, clear fingers and nails, physically plausible cloth weave, seams, buttons and shoe leather. Remove the degraded swirly embossed false texture, smudges, painterly edges, waxy skin and low-resolution artifacts. Fabrics should have natural small-scale weave, NOT ornate swirling patterns invented by earlier generations. Preserve original colors, character age and expression, all accessories and clothing design. No beautification or age reduction.
Unified visual standard across cast: realistic neutral daylight studio lighting, soft frontal key and fill, restrained natural contrast, accurate skin tone, sharp focus across the full figure, clean white seamless backdrop, subtle foot contact shadow. Straight-on eye-level full-body view, arms relaxed at sides, all hair and shoes visible, single person centered. No portrait crop, no low-angle lens distortion, no dramatic grading, no cartoon, no 3D render, no illustration, no glossy plastic skin, no oversharpening halos, no added labels, no text. The output must improve image detail and photographic quality while faithfully preserving the approved character and body proportions.
